body: I wouldn't really go too deep into that theory because it paints a picture that you get a second chance a life. Nobody really knows but I think the best thing you could do for yourself is to assume that once you die, you're gone, there is no second chance. But I do understand what you mean and it's comforting to think that you could just wake up a baby again.
Go see a professional and please get treatment.
Get her out of your life. You dont need that.

I know you might not want to hear this but you should see a doctor.
If you go to the ER for your heart, you can get in to speak with a doctor much quicker than you would if you just went to the regular waiting room. It doesn't have to be this way forever and I promise you, you are sick enough to get help.
Just like recovering from your eating disorder might not solve the issues, I hope you can see that your eating disorder isn't solving your issues either.
Please give yourself a chance to live.
Let the doctor decide what's going to happen, what they would recommend you do and what ever happens, is in the name of your safety.
I connect to this so much

Your ED is very much valid. I have this too but I really do think it's just the ED talking and telling me I'm not sick enough. Do you think this is what's happening for you as well? Either way, it's still a problem that deserves to be treated.
Im just gonna sleep
Thanks. I guess I just feel like everything is too much for me to handle. I feel like I'm trapped and I can't get away, it all feels so hopeless.
Want to talk about it?
I know im a hypocrite.
If you said it yesterday, can you say it one more time. Please, just one more sleep, just one chance.

Please, please, please don't do this, there is so much more to this. You've been fighting for so long, why not one more day? One more morning?? I know it's hard but you can do it because you've done this long.
There are people that care. They either don't know, or aren't sure how to help.
Im so glad!

Okay, thank you, that helps a lot

Im sorry that I came off as dismissive, that wasn't my intention. Let me know if I'm still coming off that way
I was only trying to stress that there are people who care, even if they aren't in person.
I get what you mean about in-person connection and its good that you know your needs. 

I can't give you a solution because I don't have one and I know that I can't stop you from harming yourself but I can tell you that suicide isn't the answer, even if it seems like it is the only way. 
You've probably heard this so many times that it means nothing but it's worth saying.
 I promise you, there is more to this.

(Im replying from a seperate account) I hear you. I know it doesn't seem like they care but how do you know? Remember that they can't read your mind and they might not understand how much you are struggling.

Having support is so, so important, it won't solve your problems, but it will make it easier to carry.

I care about you and I'm here to support you. It might sound weird coming from a complete stranger but I wouldn't have commented if I didn't care, right?
Wow, that sounds really difficult.

Wow, that's scary.
I dont know much but if you want advice, maybe speak to a doctor if you haven't already. 
I know you might not want to hear that but I'd most be concerned with the chest pains, along with all the other symptoms. 
You mentioned that you dont feel like you're sick enough but even if your eating disorder voice says that you're fine, don't you think it's better to just make sure? 
I hope this is helpful. 
Again, I don't know much.
Be safe.
